integrity: The proof is analytic. It uses the exact tied-maximum probability for one sample index, an elementary tail cutoff, coordinate independence, and a union bound. No finite experiment or numerical search is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies identical-coordinate products only; heterogeneous product marginals remain outside the claim. In the no-terminal-atom case it proves zero liminf, not a general full-sequence rate or convergence theorem.
title: A complete leader-property classification for identical product marginals
